coefficient.basis_reconstruction_error: bound-normalized six-channel residual RMSE versus full Teacher Upper Bound residual
coefficient.coefficient_mae: continuous raw rank-4 prediction MAE versus true endpoint coefficient
coefficient.coefficient_rmse: continuous raw rank-4 prediction RMSE versus true endpoint coefficient
coefficient.endpoint_coefficient_error: L2 selected raw endpoint versus true raw endpoint

efficiency.active_gaussian_count: Gaussians passing the frozen renderer active test
efficiency.forward_time: batch-one aggregation plus predictor and endpoint selection
efficiency.render_time: frozen deformation plus renderer after selection
efficiency.timing_protocol: 20 warm-up then 100 synchronized iterations; median and IQR

identification.confusion_matrix: rows true garment, columns selected endpoint
identification.macro_5way_top1: unweighted mean of five per-garment recalls
identification.per_garment_recall: TP_g divided by true unique test queries for g
identification.protocol_weighted: mean over 20 protocol records per rotation
identification.unique_query: mean after grouping identical logical_input_sha256 values

mild_blur.scope: RGB inside clothing mask; restore outside pixels

reference_dropout.complete_dropout: all validity zero; require ABSTAIN_EMPTY_REFERENCE plus Base Avatar, not garment recovery

single_reference.report: full identification, coefficient, render, and safety metrics

primary_denominator.duplicate_policy: report protocol-weighted and unique-query metrics; duplicates never add training weight
primary_denominator.records: test-partition pure AAA/BBB protocol records only

render.endpoint_parity: ground-truth class replacement must make CanonDressGS-Endpoint and Outfit-ID Oracle select identical coefficients and produce exact residual/render parity
render.identity_metric: protected-mask mean absolute RGB difference against Base Avatar

lpips.crop: garment bbox plus 5 percent, aspect-preserving resize and zero pad to 256x256

render.protected_lpips: LPIPS inside target_protected_mask against Base Avatar render
render.reference: Teacher Upper Bound at identical pose and camera
render.rgb_mae: mean absolute RGB error inside target garment mask

severe_artifact_grade.review_policy: review all unique primary test queries without cherry-picking

render.silhouette_iou: binary alpha>=0.5 versus target garment mask>=0.5

safety.empty_render: no foreground alpha>=0.5 or empty-render grade greater than zero
safety.identity_contamination: unique test query count with identity grade greater than zero
safety.severe_wrong_outfit_endpoint: wrong endpoint and wrong-outfit grade equals 3
safety.wrong_outfit_endpoint: selected endpoint differs from true garment
